question: The center of gravity of an aero plane is that point through which the total mass of the aero plane is said to act. The weight acts in a direction
options: governed by the distribution of the mass within the aero plane

question: When an aero plane is stationary on the ground, its total weight will act vertically
options: through a point defined as the datum point

question: The weight of an aero plane, which is in level non accelerated flight, is said to act
options: vertically through the center of gravity
always along the vertical axis of the aero plane

question: The center of gravity of an aero plane
options: may only be moved if permitted by the regulating authority and endorsed in the aero plane's certificate of airworthiness
must be maintained in a fixed position by careful distribution of the load
can be allowed to move between defined limits

question: The center of gravity is the
options: center of thrust along the longitudinal axis, in relation to a datum line
neutral point along the longitudinal axis, in relation to a datum line

question: The center of gravity of a body is that point
options: where the sum of the external forces is equal to zero
which is always used as datum when computing moments

question: An aero plane is loaded with its center of gravity towards the rear limit. This will result in:
options: a reduction in power required for a given speed

question: When the center of gravity is at the forward limit, an aero plane will be:
options: extremely stable and will require excessive elevator control to change pitch
extremely unstable and require excessive elevator control to change pitch
extremely stable and require small elevator control to change pitch

question: What determines the longitudinal stability of an aero plane?
options: The relationship of thrust and lift to weight and drag
The location of the center of gravity with respect to the neutral point

question: An aero plane is said to be "neutrally stable". This is likely to:
options: causes the center of gravity to move forwards
be caused by a center of gravity which is towards the forward limit
be caused by a center of gravity which is towards the rearward limit

options: require elevator trim which will result in an increase in fuel consumption

question: If the center of gravity of an aero plane moves forward during flight the elevator control will:
options: become heavier making the aero plane more difficult to maneuver in pitch

become heavier making the aero plane more easy to maneuver in pitch

question: The position of the center of gravity can always be determined by:
options: subtracting the total moment from the total mass

dividing the total mass by the total moment

question: The stalling speed of an aero plane will be highest when it is loaded with a:
